Togui'ler genellikle düşük zekâya sahipt: Toguis generally have low intelligence.  Although the Togui Sorcerers have the highest intelligence among them, this is only relative.  Because of this, Toguis felt the need to record their wisdom so as not to forget it, and they wrote with animal blood on old piles of paper.  This is called the Spell Paper.  It contains a variety of their cultural insights, anything from curses small and large, how to create and breathe life into a puppet, to the procedures of a ritual to drive out ill fortune.  This is of great value to any scholar who studies the level of the Togui intelligence.
Elder Staff, bir şeften diğerine geçer v: The Elder Staff, pass down from one chief to the next, symbolizes the absolute authority of the chief.  Although its shape may vary from one tribe to the next, it is generally made of a thick wooden stick with a monkey skull mounted on top, small stakes inserted on the sides and pebbles with holes hanging off of them.  The shiny pebbles each represent the sun, the moon, fire, water and earth.  The wooden stick represents the forest and the skull the afterlife.  Toguis believed that their chief oversaw all of this, and those who would act against this authority would receive the divine punishment.  Thus, they did not think to challenge the chief's authority.
Flame Dağı'nın mutasyona uğramış çiçek t:
One of the mutant breed of flowers on the Flame Mountain, these flowers bloom not in petals but in buds of beautiful flame.  They absorb nutrients through fire energy instead of water, and they also act as the energy house of fire.  This makes them popular among monsters who favor fire, and many transactions, small and large, take place at a black market on the Flame Mountain on any given day.
The story of Flame Witches and Flame Ghosts fighting for seven days and seven nights for these flowers is something of an old legend on the Flame Mountain.

Orijinal olarak Heavenly Dağları'nın ila: Originally a thing of the divine realm preserved by the divine spirits of the Heavenly Mountains, this book contains the secrets to control all the fire in the world at will.  The Flame Cow King deceived the divine spirits and supposedly stole this book and brought it into this world.  After bringing the book out into this world, it is said, the Flame Cow King created his base, the Flame Mountain, with his new powers.  The power of the Book of Flames is behind the ever-raging fire of the Flame Mountain.
Flame Ghost, Flame Cow King'in Book of F: The Flame Ghost was a thousand-year-old monster who ruled the region before the Flame Cow King created the Flame Mountain with the Book of Flames.  Although his rule had continued for a long time, the appearance of the Flame Cow King shook the very roots of his rule.  The Flame Ghost was eventually defeated by the Flame Cow King.  Having lost his power and authority, the Flame Ghost turned into stone, torn to hundreds of pieces and scattered throughout the Flame Mountain.  This stone contains the venomous resentment of the Flame Ghost; a weak person would lose his mind simply by grabbing the stone.  A rumor has it that one can achieve outstanding effects when this stone is used as an ingredient for the cursed wine.
Flame Cow King'in eşi Nachalnyeo'nun üze: A necklace cherished by the Flame Cow King's wife, Nachalnyeo, this originally belonged to a Flame Witch.  The Flame Witch was reputed to be the most beautiful one on the Flame Mountain.  Jealous of her beauty, Nachalnyeo lured her out with lies and stole her necklace.  The necklace is said to contain the witch's power to enchant others.  Nachalnyeo has supposedly benefited greatly from this power when she seduced the Flame Cow King.
Flame Cow King'in oğlu Honghaea'nın yakl: Armor crafted by the Flame Cow King himself for the age of coming ceremony for his son, Honghaea.  It is a well-known tale that the Flame Cow King cut off one of his horns to create this armor.  This also proves the depth of his love for his son.  When Honghaea was defeated by Sonogong, and this armor was returned with his body, the Flame Cow King is said to have cried standing for a full week before the armor, not moving an inch.
Flame Cow King, savaş tanrısı lakabına u: Flame Cow King is a very powerful monster, fitting his nickname of god of war.  His strength was great enough to defeat most enemies without using a weapon.  Only when he met a worthy opponent would he draw the Fire Dragon Sword.  There was no one who could wield this weapon, which weighs about 1200 kilos, with any skill.  This weapon is also the only one able to match Sonogong's weapons.
Sevgilisi Ceila tarafından Alberto'ya se: This was given to Alberto as a gift by his lover, Ceila, on the day he set sail.  Judging by the traditional belief that silver has the power to drive away demons, it is speculated that this was given to Alberto as a charm to keep him safe.  It can be opened, and a small portrait of Ceila is placed inside.  Alberto did not let go of this charm to his final moments.
Sefere çıkmasından kısa süre sonra, Albe: Not long after setting sail, Alberto's ship encountered a pirate ship.  Once he barely escaped their pursuit hiding in a rocky region, he later struck them back successfully by laying ambush.  With it, all the booty of the pirates came into the possession of Alberto and his men.  The loot most cherished by Alberto was this cobalt emerald.  Alberto is said to have missed Ceila greatly, looking at the emerald which represents youthful innocence.  With this, he planned to ask her hand in marriage upon his return - except that he did not return.
Alberto'nun tuttuğu kaptanın günlüğü. B: Captain's log recorded by Alberto.  This log records all of his adventures out on the open sea.  It mentions Ceila throughout, showing how much Alberto missed her.  Judging by what is recorded in the log, it seems that Alberto's journey has been mostly uneventful other than his encounter with the pirates.  However, the encounter with the Kraken at the end seems to be the conclusive factor in the sinking of his ship.
Alberto'nun Ceila için yazmış olduğu bir: A letter for Ceila written by Alberto himself.  A long letter of five pages, it is filled with his love and longing for her from top to finish.  He had originally planned to mail it to her once he arrived at the port.  However, this letter could not be sent due to the sinking of the ship when he encountered the Kraken.  Now, the letter rests with the shipwreck deep in the abyss.
Alberto'nun sevgilisi Ceila'nın bir resm: A portrait of Ceila, Alberto's lover.  When Alberto's ship did not return after the appointed time, people assumed that he was now dead.  However, Ceila refused to believe them and waited for her love at the port for years.  Then, all of a sudden, she vanished one day.  Some said that she succumbed to her longing for Alberto and threw herself into the ocean, while others claimed that she agreed to a pact with a sea witch, searching the seas for Alberto as a mermaid.
Bu kutu, Epsilon denilen korsanların, bö: This box is full of treasure collected by pirates by the name of the Epsilons as they ambushed merchant ships passing through their territory.  The box is filled with anything from ordinary gold coins to various rare treasures.  However, the Epsilons were defeated by Alberto and all the treasure was taken away.  Having lost his treasure and his pride damaged, the captain of the Epsilons, Giler, began pursuing Alberto with bitter resentment.  As they awoke the abysmal monster, Kraken, towards the end of the pursuit, the situation got out of hand.
Ortasında büyük bir elmas olan cep saati: A pocket with a large diamond set in the middle.  The beautiful luster and the outer appearance testify to its high value.  As such, this item is mainly traded among the nobles.  Alberto took it from the jewelry box of the Epsilons.  However, with the sinking of the ship, this watch sank to the bottom of the sea along with its value.
Bir denizkızının sertleşmiş gözyaşından: A gem made from hardened teardrops of a mermaid.  A mermaid began appearing at the shipwreck site and ceaselessly cried looking at the remains of the ship.  It is said that she looked so mysterious and yet so sad that no one could dare approach her.  Some claim that this is Ceila, who turned into a mermaid in search of Alberto.  When she couldn't find her lover, they say, she came all the way out here.
Giler'in, şimdi okyanusun dibinde buluna: This is the Giler's damaged pirate ship now sunken into the ocean.  The hull is heavily damaged, as if to testify to the desperation of the final moments before sinking.  The water spirit, Sereness, never approached this sunken pirate ship, because of her memories with her beloved Giler.  So great was Sereness' sorrow that no one could approach the ship except monsters and ghosts.
Bunlar, King Nippers'in kırık pençelerid: These are the broken claws of King Nippers.  When Sereness appeared before Giler in the human form was when Giler's pirate ship was in danger surrounded by a group of King Nippers.  After defeating the King Nippers and rescuing Giler, she fell in love with him, a human - an unthinkable deed for a spirit.  Even though she knew that she was only being used by him, she could do nothing else but help them because of her love.
Korsan gemisi battıktan ve Giler öldükte: After the pirate ship sank and Giler died, great sorrow and pain tormented Sereness.  It is said that Sereness acquired the Harp of Dreams from a sea witch to erase her own memory.  However, after erasing Giler from her memories seven times, she remembered him against seven times.  Memories may be erased, but love is etched on one's heart, never to be erased.  Sereness' sorrow continued on ever since.
Denizlerin düzenini sağlamak, su perisi: It was Sereness' duty as a water spirit to maintain the order of the seas.  Fallen into great sorrow after Giler's death, she drove herself as a ruthless warrior in order that she might forget everything.  Her sword, mercilessly wielded, defeated numerous monsters.  Sereness is said to have taken enough hearts of monsters to form a mountain.
Sereness'in, acılı kalbini çıkarıp, kede: Sereness is said to have taken out her sorrowful heart and hidden it in order to hide her grief.  This heart is the bead of vindictive spirit.  However, no matter how hard she tried to abandon her sorrow, her soul was ultimately not redeemed.  Rather, this attracted many monsters to the abyss that consume evil energy.
Kanca şeklindeki bu yapay el, Epsilon'la: This artificial hand in the shape of a hook is the hand of Giler, the pirate captain of the Epsilons.  Once notorious for pillaging small and large out on the open seas, Giler was defeated by Alberto.  With his pride damaged, he pursued Alberto to the end for revenge.  When his pursuit failed, he made the foolish choice of using Sereness to awake Kraken in the abyss.  He was successful in burying Alberto in the abyss - but not before he, too, was buried in the same sea.
Bu göz bandı, Epsilon'ların korsan kapta: This eye patch was used by Giler, the pirate captain of the Epsilons.  He supposedly began wearing this eye patch when he lost one of his eyes during a pursuit by the naval fleet.  He faced more perils after that, almost losing his life.  He tenaciously continued to survive and took his place as the pirate captain.
Bu taş, Sereness'in sertleşmiş gözyaşlar: This gem is the hardened tears of Sereness.  After witnessing the death of the pirate captain, Giler, with her own eyes, she is said to have shed tears, lost in the flow of time.  This gem contains her sorrow, love, and resentment.  She never even came close to the shipwreck since then in order not to stir memories of Giler.  Many of her tears are said to be still resting near the shipwreck.
